name: TRIO Upward Bound
what_you_do: Meet with an advisor during the school year and spend six summer weeks living on campus. You take enrichment classes and go on field trips. It prepares you for college.
who_can_apply: Students at Senior, Skyview, West, Hardin or Lockwood high schools who finished 8th grade, are a U.S. citizen or permanent resident, and want to go to college. Your parents must not have a four-year degree, and your family must meet income rules. The page does not list the income limits.
pay_detail: Free. Summer students can get a stipend of up to $90.
duration: Six weeks in summer plus school-year advising
deadline_text: Not stated on the program page.
how_to_apply: Get a paper application from the Upward Bound staff. Return it to your school counselor or mail it in. Eligible students get an interview. Phone: 406-657-2116. Email: upwardbound@msubillings.edu.
notes: Students not selected go on a waiting list. Selection looks at grades, recommendations and the interview. The program page does not say if the summer program is free. The summer page says students can get a stipend of up to $90.
